next_step_summary: PR #219 implements the physical preprocessing consumer over the merged PR #218 safe-crop producer. The native path recomputes crop evidence from the current module-owned bounded preview, validates source/session and crop geometry internally, conservatively maps accepted preview bounds to oriented full resolution, renders a fixed-frame grayscale transform and crops only when fully accepted; any rotation_only/full_frame_fallback evidence produces a 0-degree grayscale full-frame fallback. The development UI now shows the final prepared grayscale artifact with decision, dimensions, applied rotation, source-space crop box and fallback reasons. No perspective correction, OCR recognition, upload, backend/provider, dependency, permission or workflow change is introduced. Next run android-document-preprocess-device-smoke-v1 on the two owner-controlled photographed contract sets, checking that useful page content is preserved, crop is conservative, grayscale remains readable, fallback cases keep the full frame, and repeated-page use does not crash or exhaust memory. A concrete in-contract defect may reopen only the affected preprocessing area; otherwise return to the deferred serverless-gpu-ocr-viability-benchmark-v1.
